newsitem.title: UK: SocGen hires retail analyst Bubb.
newsitem.headline: SocGen hires retail analyst Bubb.

text.p: SocGen, the London-based investment banking arm of French bank Societe Generale, said it has hired retail analyst Nick Bubb from MeesPierson as part of efforts to bolster its equity sales and research coverage.

Bubb, 42, is among the best-known retail analysts in London. He was among the top-rated sector specialists in his seven years at Morgan Stanley, where he worked prior to joining MeesPierson -- bought by Dutch-Belgian financial group Fortis in March -- in 1995.
SocGen head of research Paul Diggle said Bubb would join as director of UK retail research, following the retirement of one of the investment bank's retail analysts.
Diggle said SocGen expected to increase its equity headcount by about 40 during 1997, mainly in sales and research posts.
With about 90 percent of the FTSE 100 index now covered at SocGen, Diggle said one objective was to increase coverage of companies in continental Europe.
